textSegments: Hydro G PRO | Power Supplies (PSU) | FSP
Full protections: OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP
More Powerful with a Compact Size

New HYDRO G Pro series upgraded from original HYDRO G, took the best features of HYDRO G series and made them even better. With a smaller size, HYDRO G Pro improves its performance with more powerful output that gives you ultra-performance.

FSP Group features the latest in green power technology, and provides a full array of additional safety approvals to keep designs ahead of the changing regulations. FSP has upgraded the majority of our power supplies to comply with the new IEC/EN 62368 standard for your gaming rigs.
Hydro G Pro series is a power supply with 80 PLUS® Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power and reduces electricity cost.
ECO Switch, Quieter and Longer Lasting Fan

When Eco Button is switched on, the PSU runs with lower power consumption and is whisper silent. The fan in the power supply will not operate when the power supply is under 30% loading for silent state.
HYDRO G Pro series comes with FDB fan and intelligent 0dBA function to reduce noise, and features a longer-lasting life.

Corresponds to a variety of the latest CPU platforms. Complies with Intel ATX12V V2.52 power supply design guide to make sure the peak power in 12V supports the latest Intel / AMD platforms and delivers full power to your PC system.

The ATX 12V CPU power connector is able to support CPUs with sufficient wattage and the latest motherboard, Z390. HYDRO G PRO series from 650W to 1000W packages dual power connectors more than regular PSUs, and provide the stable and peak output to your new rig requires.
Fully Modular Design for Quick and Easy Installation
Fully modular design simplifies installation and allows you to use only the cables you need, for a neater and cleaner build.
Hydro G Pro is covered with conformal coatings to guarantee reliable performance in a harsh environment. It can work perfectly with 95%RH while others cannot.
LLC Half Bridge Topology with DC-DC Module Design
New HYDRO G Pro series features extremely tight voltage regulation to make the output voltage regulation under +/- 1% at any load changes, and offer you supreme efficiency and voltage stability.
FSP is committed to manufacturing high-quality and reliable power supplies. The Hydro G Pro series is backed by our 10-year warranty for both parts and labor.
